pages.title: History
pages.content:
Sixty-four years, one decision at a time

Ishizue Holdings B.V. was founded in 1962 in Rotterdam by Kenzo Ishizue and Anneke de Vries as a stone and aggregates trader on the Maas. The full history, with every company that joined, follows here.

pages.title: Group companies
pages.content:
Six companies, one owner

Ishizue Materials, Northquay Logistics, Lindholm Precision, Verda Facilities, Calder Food Partners and Ishizue Renewables keep their names, their bases and their local management.

pages.title: Leadership
pages.content:
The people who answer for the group

Grace Abernethy chairs the board, Daniel Okoro is group CEO and Sofia Marchetti is CFO.

pages.title: Governance
pages.content:
Owned for the long term

The Ishizue Foundation holds the majority of Ishizue Holdings B.V. Seven board members sit, four of them independent.

pages.title: Investors
pages.content:
Reports, notices and dates

Ishizue is privately held and publishes reports and notices because the board chooses to. Next: Q3 trading update on 12 Nov 2026.

pages.title: Sustainability
pages.content:
Building on what lasts

Ishizue Renewables has fitted forty rooftops totalling 38 MW, and Verda trains forty technician apprentices each year.

pages.title: For owners
pages.content:
When you are ready to pass it on

We buy companies to keep them: the name, the management and the sites stay. Arjun Mehta, Head of Investments, takes the first conversation, which is free and confidential.

pages.title: Shared services
pages.content:
Our back office, at fixed fees

Independent companies of 20 to 300 people can share our back office at published fees, from €38 per employee per month for payroll and HR administration.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Maaskade 41, Rotterdam

Ishizue Holdings B.V., Maaskade 41, 3071 NE Rotterdam, Netherlands. Reception is open Monday to Friday, 08:30–17:30 CET, and visits are by appointment on Tuesday and Thursday.
